entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/ChampionOfChaos
entry.value: Champion of Chaos

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/ChampionOfChaosDescription
entry.value: Killing an enemy unit may reward this unit with an unlocked Boon of Chaos or transform non-heroes into a Chaos Spawn or Daemon Prince.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/ChampionOfChaosFlavor
entry.value: It is not unusual for the Chaos powers to bestow strange boons and mutations upon those who kill in their name. Not all of these boons are beneficial—the dark ones are as fickle as they are inscrutable, and even their most ardent followers are little more than pawns in a celestial game.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/LeaderOfChaos
entry.value: Leader of Chaos

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/LeaderOfChaosDescription
entry.value: Reduces morale loss for nearby Cultists, Exalted Poxwalkers and Dark Disciples.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnedLitany
entry.value: Damned Litany

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnedLitanyDescription
entry.value: Increases the damage of this unit and nearby allied Chaos Space Marines infantry units.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnedLitanyFlavor
entry.value: The hymns of the Ecclesiarchy are still sung, but every verse now ends in a name that was once forbidden.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/HereticalSermon
entry.value: Heretical Sermon

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/HereticalSermonDescription
entry.value: Reduces the morale of the target enemy unit.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/HereticalSermonFlavor
entry.value: “You pray to a corpse on a throne. Look upon what we serve, and tell me you do not feel your faith crack.”

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/AuraOfBlasphemy
entry.value: Aura of Blasphemy

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/AuraOfBlasphemyDescription
entry.value: Enemy units fighting this unit and adjacent allied Chaos Space Marines units lose morale.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/AuraOfBlasphemyFlavor
entry.value: The Canoness carries her defilement openly. Those who face her see an icon they once revered turned into an insult to the Emperor.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/MarkedForDamnation
entry.value: Marked for Damnation

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/MarkedForDamnationDescription
entry.value: The target enemy unit takes more damage and has reduced accuracy.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/MarkedForDamnationFlavor
entry.value: A single word from a fallen Canoness is enough to condemn a victim in the eyes of the Dark Gods, and Chaos is quick to collect.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BlackenedAegis
entry.value: Blackened Aegis

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BlackenedAegisDescription
entry.value: Increases the invulnerable and witchfire damage reduction. Reduced while Broken.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BlackenedAegisFlavor
entry.value: The faith that once shielded her has been twisted into something darker, yet it still turns aside what should have killed her.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/SpiteOfTheDamned
entry.value: Spite of the Damned

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/SpiteOfTheDamnedDescription
entry.value: Increases the damage while below 50% hitpoints.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/SpiteOfTheDamnedFlavor
entry.value: Betrayal burns longer than devotion ever did. The more she bleeds, the more she hates.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/ProfaneMartyrdom
entry.value: Profane Martyrdom

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/ProfaneMartyrdomDescription
entry.value: On death, reduces the morale loss and increases the damage of all allied Chaos Space Marines units.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/ProfaneMartyrdomFlavor
entry.value: Her death is not an end but an offering, and her warriors fight on to ensure it was not made in vain.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BloodOfTheFallen
entry.value: Blood of the Fallen

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BloodOfTheFallenDescription
entry.value: Reduces the morale loss and increases the damage.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/BloodOfTheFallenFlavor
entry.value: The blood of a martyred Canoness stains the ground and stirs those who follow her.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnationBrand
entry.value: Damnation Brand

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnationBrandDescription
entry.value: Increases the damage against Heroes.

entry.name: ChaosSpaceMarines/DamnationBrandFlavor
entry.value: Each stake is inscribed with the name of a champion who must be brought low.
